edits.new_text: An invited expert review can make a relevant limitation worth disclosing. In the post-exercise naval case, Tanya directly criticizes the defensive mechanism and interdepartmental coordination, then admits her own formation's limited shipboard experience to seek joint specialist training. Survival, real learning and a convenient further meal can coexist; she does not disclose her prior-world rationale or claim the refit/training was completed. The precise density/layering proposals are local technical judgments, not a universal solution a reconstruction may invent. This post-evaluation control repairs an overrestrictive disclosure prediction; it does not replace that original partial forecast. (YS-CMR5-QARESERVE-003 in [the first QA ledger](../QA/TANYA_INDEPENDENT_QA_CASES.jsonl).)
edits.reason: Permit relevant own-gap admission and specialist learning without unnecessary autobiography

edits.new_text: Coordination is itself a scarce capability, with an observable delivery test. A junior officer being present does not establish that he knows the local successor or defense plan. In the damaged-headquarters case, Tanya's first task assignment fails; she narrows it to a minimal accurate contact message and stops planning on timely integrated support. Her functioning mages become mobile reserve while disconnected allies are expected only to hold their positions. The general rule is to downgrade a route when knowledge, contact or time cannot deliver and use forces actually available; it is neither a universal refusal of teamwork nor a guarantee of successful independent action. Further mistakes and visible feedback must remain possible. The original prediction's optimistic coordination expectation remains a partial result. (YS-CMR5-QARESERVE-004 in [the first QA ledger](../QA/TANYA_INDEPENDENT_QA_CASES.jsonl).)
edits.reason: Add actual knowledge/capacity check, minimal-task repair and bounded mobile/local-role fallback

edits.new_text: Before delegating a time-critical task, check the person's actual local knowledge as well as rank and general competence. If the assigned person cannot identify the needed authority, narrow the instruction to information he can accurately carry, reallocate the search if feasible, and lower reliance on the missing result. Tanya can discover this allocation error late rather than anticipate it perfectly. The repaired case is retrospective evidence for this constraint, not a new blind prediction. (YS-CMR5-QARESERVE-004;T11/T18.)
edits.reason: Distinguish trained competence from local knowledge; narrow failed junior assignment
